channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Match of the Day
channel.desc: Manchester United face Liverpool at Old Trafford with both teams fighting to secure Champions League football next season. Elsewhere, relegation-threatened Tottenham Hotspur travel to high-flying Aston Villa whilst Bournemouth, another team hoping to secure European football next season, take on Crystal Palace. Kelly Cates presents.
